pages.title: The fen's own
text: Among the reeds and mud channels live a hopper, a wading strider and a floater, and at night something coiled wakes in the grass.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with that same reagent. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Marsh Hopper
text: A small, quick hopper in groups of two to four. **12 health**, no armour.
It drops **1 to 3 Marsh Feet**, more with Looting.

pages.title: Fen Strider
text: A tall, long-legged wader in herds of two to four. **22 health** and **1 armour**.

pages.title: Bog Floater
text: A green floater that drifts over the fen in ones to threes. **12 health**, no armour. A few drift along with the [Colossus Warden](colossus_warden).

pages.title: Reed Coil
text: A coiled, scaled hunter that rises on the fen's open ground at night, one to three at a time. It is very slow, but it has **30 health** and **6 armour**, hits for **5** and shoves you back with every blow.
It drops **1 to 2 Reed Whorls**, a Shove reagent.
